items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: So after we got through playing a song, John was playing a solo.

ctx.x: And he played--he could play a ballad, you know, he could really swoon on them ballads. So we started playing, man, so--and he came down there and he said "who told ya'll to start playing?" So we told him, say "the club owner asked us to start playing." "Well who's paying you--the club owner or me?" So everybody say well, wait a minute, now we don't want to get involved in this stuff, you know, to who's paying who, you know what I mean. Said that--so everybody clammed up.
